description: Register a webhook endpoint for the chosen event types. Response is a `{ webhook, secret }` envelope — the HMAC-SHA256 SIGNING SECRET is returned once and the caller MUST store it to verify event signatures.

campaign_ids.description: Restrict to events from these campaigns. Empty array = events from every campaign.

description.description: Free-form label shown in the dashboard.

event_types.description: Event-type slugs to subscribe to (see `list_webhook_event_types`). Empty array = subscribe to ALL events.

name: create_webhook
title: Create Webhook
